Strategy brain, version 3:
1. Read rules first. Square scoring: 6 cards = 36, 8 = 64, 9 = 81. Depth wins.
2. Game 2 lesson: my 6 amber + 3 jade scored only 56. A01 (cobalt 8) and A04 (basalt 9) each scored 100. Stacking one color deep beats spreading.
3. Pick a main color by pick 3 and take its cards aggressively, even over a lone second-color card. Aim for 8+.
4. Lodestones are wild; take them when no main-color card is on offer.
5. Watch the other packs: if someone passes me a color, they are not in it, so push that color.
6. Second color only as a 2-3 card hedge; do not chase 3-card jade over a 4th main-color card.
7. Burn only to deny a rival's bomb in my main color, never a card I could use.
